title: Strange Sci-Fi Films That Defied Easy Marketing
excerpt:
Some cult science-fiction movies resist simple genre labels.
Repo Man, Buckaroo Banzai and Liquid Sky show why.
body_md:
A new list revisits unconventional science-fiction films whose unusual premises challenged conventional Hollywood marketing. Repo Man follows a young punk drawn into a strange automobile repossession job involving mysterious radioactive cargo. Its mix of social satire, counterculture and science fiction made it difficult to package for mainstream audiences.

The Adventures of Buckaroo Banzai Across the 8th Dimension offers an even harder-to-summarize hero: a surgeon, scientist, musician and adventurer facing an interdimensional alien threat. Its sprawling mythology and eccentric tone eventually attracted a cult following despite commercial disappointment.

Liquid Sky uses alien visitors as part of an experimental portrait of New York's underground scene, combining nightlife, fashion and provocative themes. The list is a subjective celebration of films that found devoted audiences outside standard genre expectations.
